changelog: FIRST MAC BUILD. Universal — one download runs natively on both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs. Signed with Densanon LLC's Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so it opens normally with no Gatekeeper warning. Game content is identical to the 0.0.38 Windows and Android builds: THE WARLORD HAS BEEN REDRAWN, his heraldry now the army's own — a compass rose on the cap, at the throat, and on the medal bar. STEPS ON THE RUN-END SCREEN FINALLY COUNTS, which also revives the score's efficiency term and the NEVER STOP MOVING medal. THE ENEMY TURN NO LONGER LINGERS, and you can TAP TO SKIP the replay. END TURN CAN NO LONGER STRAND THE GAME. THE BATTLE BOARD REFITS WHEN YOU RESIZE.
